description: The refs that use `ref`: what would break if it moved or changed.

from.description: A path inside the project (the file you are editing; relative to its root with `project`), in a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name or root, when no path is at hand.

ref.description: A Strapi ref: a content-type or component UID (api::article.article, shared.seo), a service/controller/policy/middleware ref (plugin::users-permissions.user, global::is-owner) or a route handler (api::article.article.find); `ref#method` for one method.

name: dependents
title: What uses a ref (incoming edges)
